name: EAA & ADA Accessibility Risk Lead Enrichment via Apify (WCAG 2.2 + Overlay Detector)

parameters.content:
## WCAG 2.2 / EAA & ADA Lead Enrichment Setup

1. Set environment variable **`APIFY_API_TOKEN`** in n8n (Settings -> Variables or Docker env).
2. Set **`APIFY_ACTOR_ID`** (e.g. `your-username~wcag-eaa-ada-auditor` — note the `~` tilde separator required by Apify REST API v2).
3. Replace the sample URLs in **Set Prospect URLs** with your Google Sheets, HubSpot, Apollo, or Clay webhook source.
4. Cost: **$0.01/run + $0.025/URL** (+$0.015/URL if `includeVisualEvidence: true`).
